```{=html}
<div class="ab-section-header">
<h2 class="ab-section-title">About Me</h2>
</div>
<div class="ab-prose">
<p>I'm Jubayer Hossain, a computational cancer biologist in Dhaka, Bangladesh. My current research focuses on tumor evolution, therapy resistance, and metastasis in aggressive cancers. I am motivated by the urgent need for better treatments for cancers that have few therapeutic options.</p>
<p>I use single-cell multi-omics approaches to trace how tumor cells diversify over time, which cell states survive treatment, and how they acquire the ability to spread. I then test those findings in independent public patient cohorts.</p>
</div>

<div class="ab-section-header">
<h2 class="ab-section-title">Backstory</h2>
</div>
<div class="ab-prose">
<p>I came to biology wanting to be a data scientist, drawn to the idea of answering important biological questions with data. During my undergraduate studies in microbiology at Jagannath University, I found my place in computational biology, even though my program offered no computational coursework.</p>
<p>In June 2020, after finishing my MS in Microbiology, I founded <a href="https://chiralbd.github.io" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CHIRAL Bangladesh</a>, a non-profit research institute that has since trained 3,000+ early-career researchers. In 2025 I founded <a href="https://deepbioltd.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">DeepBio Limited</a>, where I lead a team of 13 researchers running single-cell and bulk RNA-Seq pipelines for cancer genomics, and <a href="https://deepbioacademy.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">DeepBio Academy</a>, where I teach bioinformatics through project-based courses.</p>
</div>

<div class="ab-section-header">
<h2 class="ab-section-title">Research Interests</h2>
</div>
<div class="ab-prose">
<ul>
<li>Tumor evolution and clonal heterogeneity</li>
<li>Mechanisms of therapy resistance</li>
<li>Metastasis and tumor cell plasticity</li>
<li>Tumor microenvironment</li>
<li>Single-cell multi-omics</li>
</ul>
</div>
```
